title: Merge intervals (Python)
description: Sorts intervals by start, then sweeps: overlapping intervals merge into one, disjoint ones start a new group. The standard calendar-consolidation algorithm.
how_it_works: Lab exercise: type the snippet into a fresh file, run it, and confirm the test outputs match. Then change one input and predict the result before running — Sorting makes overlaps adjacent; the sweep extends the current interval while the next start falls inside it.
pitfalls: Touching intervals ([1,4],[4,5]): decide merge-or-not and be consistent.
